$comment: The autonomous-lane build envelope — the SINGLE source of truth for what an unattended Claude session may not change. Prose copies (CLAUDE.md, governor/SKILL.md, ship/SKILL.md, orient.md) cite this file rather than restating the list; restating it is how the wording drifted before (several copies dropped 'and hard to reverse' from CLAUDE.md's original). Enforced by scripts/envelope-scan.mjs via tests/arch/envelope.spec.ts.
$diffAwareComment: Eric, 2026-08-27 — a protected file marked 'diffAware': true is exempt from the hold ONLY when the actual diff is provably safe, one of THREE ways (scripts/envelope-scan.mjs's classifyDiff/structurallySafe/behaviorVerified, cheapest first): (1) pure insertion — every hunk adds lines only, no existing line removed or changed, AND no added line introduces a new mutating broker call (.post(/.put(/.delete(/fetch(); (2) a safe token-level structural widening (e.g. a union type gaining a member — #716/#858); (3) behavior-verified (#852, broad slice, below) — the file's registered `invariantSuite` is untouched by the diff and passes right now. Any one path clearing it is enough; all three failing means it gates exactly as before. Marked diffAware only on the order-construction/execution cluster (calibrated against #679-#696's real diffs: 3 of 4 stayed correctly gated — one modified an existing function body, one added a brand-new cancelOrder network call; the fourth, a pure type-shape addition, would have shipped unattended). Auth, credentials, the invite gate, and workflow/deploy files are deliberately NOT diffAware — those stay hard-gated regardless of diff shape. Risk guards and playbooks (src/engine/guards.ts, src/bots/account-guard.ts, src/playbooks/**) left the protected list entirely on #928 — they carry no account-identity check, so they're ordinary open trading-feature surface, not this file's concern at all.
$behaviorEvidenceNote: #852, settled (Eric, 2026-08-29: 'the intent is behavioral tests and CI quality gates are to prevent the need for human review/intervention' — the BROAD reading, not narrow). A diffAware rule may carry `invariantSuite`, a spec file path; scripts/envelope-scan.mjs's behaviorVerified() treats a passing run of that suite, PROVIDED THE SUITE ITSELF IS UNTOUCHED BY THE DIFF, as sufficient proof to report additiveSafe:true and skip the hold — same as a pure-insertion diff does today. A diff that edits its own proof gets no credit from it (the suite must be identical to what's on `main`, where `verify` already guarantees it was passing — nothing to re-check at the base commit itself). WHERE this exemption fires, the PR body must say so explicitly (which suite, how it's unaffected) — the honesty rule this repo holds everywhere else applies to its own safety mechanism. `invariantSuite` is opt-in per rule; a diffAware file with none behaves exactly as before (#850's PoC → tests/trading/option-ticket-invariants.property.spec.ts is the first one registered, on option-ticket.ts). The narrow slice (#884, merged) — citing a suite as evidence for a human, without changing the gate — is superseded by this: the whole point named was removing the need for the human, not speeding them up.

$openOnPurpose: Deliberately NOT protected (Eric, 2026-08-22 — 'gate money-moving logic only'; sharpened 2026-08-29, #928 — 'the intent is to prevent people from changing things that explicitly belong to others... building features that everyone can use is community owned'; 2026-08-30, #928 — 'the correct idea [is] to abstract sensitive logic out so it can be fenced, this enables users to improve more parts of our application'): src/observatory/**, src/ui/**, src/three/**, everything that merely RENDERS trades, P/L, leaderboards or bot cards, AND, as of #928, src/engine/guards.ts, src/bots/account-guard.ts, src/trading/order-ticket.ts, src/trading/option-ticket.ts, src/playbooks/**, src/server/feedback-coach-limits.ts, and src/companion/companion-limits.ts — risk sizing, discipline rules, bot-account coordination, playbook authorship, and the coach/companion's round·message·token·throttle caps, none of which can reach another member's account or data, or change what model bills the real per-token rate. The honesty invariants (real tickers, truthful SIM/LIVE labels, paper-only) are a judgment stop stated in .github/prompts/feedback-build.md, not a path — no file list can enforce 'this flourish implies something false'. What stays protected in the trading cluster (desk-gate.ts, trade-service.ts, option-trade-service.ts, the Alpaca clients, credentials.ts) does so because it carries — or executes against — the actual cross-account identity check, not because it is trading-shaped; feedback-coach-model.ts and companion-model.ts stay protected for the same abstract-and-fence reason, on the money dial rather than an identity check. #928's remaining slice splits the desk-gate family's identity check out where it's currently entangled with open-able logic.
